head.title: Private Chef vs Restaurant Dubai | myCHEF
head.meta_description: Compare a private chef and restaurant dining in Dubai by setting, menu flexibility, service, preparation and the complete cost of your occasion.

opening_paragraph: The choice between a private chef and a restaurant in Dubai comes down to the experience you want. A chef at home lets you shape the setting, menu and pace; a restaurant provides its own space, facilities and established service. Compare both against your occasion and practical needs.

new_paragraphs: At home, you choose the table, music and guest list, but the kitchen and access must support the proposed meal. A restaurant provides the venue and equipment, with its own seating arrangements, opening times and house policies.

A private chef develops a menu around the agreed brief and available ingredients. Restaurants offer their current menu or a prearranged group selection. In both cases, discuss dietary requirements before booking and ask what the kitchen can safely accommodate.

For private dining, confirm shopping, equipment, service staff and kitchen clear-down. At a restaurant, check the reservation length, group-menu conditions and any minimum spend or room charge. A clear scope makes the choices easier to compare.

myCHEF offers a defined Date Night package at AED 1,200 for two and bespoke chef-led plated dining at AED 700–950 per person. Compare those inclusions with the restaurant’s food, drinks, service charges and taxes, rather than comparing headline prices alone.

Compare the complete service, including the menu, guest count, preparation, staffing, equipment, delivery and clear-down. A per-person price is useful only when the inclusions are clear. Ask which elements are fixed and which can change if your plans change.

Share allergies and other dietary requirements before confirming. The culinary partner should explain the preparation arrangements and any remaining cross-contact risk. Review the payment schedule, cancellation terms and change deadlines in your written booking.

Send the date, Dubai address, expected guest count and preferred service time, together with your menu ideas and venue details. Photos of the kitchen or service area can help the team assess what is practical.

myCHEF typically replies within 15 minutes between 9am and 11pm Dubai time. The tailored proposal follows once the requirements and availability have been reviewed. A first reply is an acknowledgement, rather than confirmation that a chef or date has been secured.
